definitions.explanation: Reproducing or reposting content (articles, images, text) that was originally published elsewhere. Often used regarding copyright and permission issues online.

examples.japanese: {無断|むだん}{転載|てんさい}{禁止|きんし}。
この{記事|きじ}を{転載|てんさい}してもいいですか。
{許可|きょか}なく{他人|たにん}の{写真|しゃしん}を{転載|てんさい}すると、{著作権|ちょさくけん}の{問題|もんだい}になる。
examples.english: Reposting someone else's photos without permission can lead to copyright issues.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{転載|てんさい} refers specifically to reproducing or reposting content from one medium or platform to another. It is commonly seen in copyright notices on websites and publications.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- を{転載|てんさい}する (to repost/reprint something)
- からの{転載|てんさい} (reprint from...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無断|むだん}{転載|てんさい} (unauthorized reproduction)
- {転載|てんさい}{禁止|きんし} (reproduction prohibited)
- {記事|きじ}を{転載|てんさい}する (repost an article)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{転載|てんさい} focuses on reproducing content across platforms. Compare with {引用|いんよう} (quotation), which refers to citing a portion of someone's work with attribution.
